I have not been able to find my "go to" Sungboon Editor Serum for at least a month. It seems to be out of stock. I have such sensitive skin and that was working really well for me. It is a little thicker than the S.E. serum and smells better. It leaves a more glassy finish and feels so good on the skin. I will definitely be adding this to my routine as the results in such a short time are already impressive. I am now thinking of getting the collagen toner they have that will probably pair well with this serum. For reference, I am a 54 year old female with aging and sensitive skin.
